label: Diagram 17.2
caption: Diagram 17.2 Provision of firefighting shafts | Location of firefighting shafts
description: Diagram 17.2, 'Provision of firefighting shafts', 'See para 17.2', titled 'Buildings in which firefighting shafts should be provided, showing which storeys need to be served', is a set of four building sections (a–d) rising above and sinking below a grey ground line, each containing a green vertical band. a. 'Any building': 'The upper storeys in any building with a storey more than 18m above fire service vehicle access level'; left dimension '> 18m' from the 'Fire service vehicle access level' line. b. 'Any building': 'The basement storeys in any building with a basement more than 10m below fire service vehicle access level'; basement dimension '> 10m'. c. 'Shop and commercial', 'assembly and recreation' and 'industrial' buildings (purpose groups 4, 5 and 6)': 'The upper storeys in purpose groups 4, 5 and 6 buildings with a storey of 900m² or more which is more than 7.5m above fire service vehicle access level'; dimension '> 7.5m'. d. 'Any building': 'The basement storeys in any building with two or more basements each exceeding 900m²'; text below: 'Two or more basement storeys each exceeding 900m²'. Legend: diagonal-lined box 'Extent of firefighting stair'; narrow box with square 'Extent of firefighting lift'. NOTES: 1. Height excludes any top storey(s) consisting exclusively of plant rooms. 2. Firefighting shafts should serve all floors through which they pass.
